text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending amendments to the existing parking regulations on the south side of Prince Arthur Avenue, between Huron Street and St. George Street. The proposed changes will assist the pick-up/drop-off of residents residing at 95 Prince Arthur Avenue. These changes will result in the loss of approximately one permit parking and pay-and-display parking space.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Prince Arthur Avenue, from a point 51 metres east of Huron Street to a point 7 metres further east. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Prince Arthur Avenue, between a point 43.5 metres east of Huron Street and a point 8.5 metres further east. 3. Designated a passenger loading zone to operate at all times on the south side of Prince Arthur Avenue, between a point 43.5 metres east of Huron Street and a point 8.5 metres further east.
